title: BALF: Budgeted Activation-Aware Low-Rank Factorization for Fine-Tuning-Free Model Compression
abstract: arXiv:2509.25136v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Activation-aware low-rank factorization techniques yield strong compression results, but they are generally confined to linear layers, and existing whitening-based theory typically makes an implicit full-rank assumption on layer activations. We introduce a layer representation framework that allows us to understand and extend low-rank factorization beyond linear layers, including standard and grouped convolutions. Within this framework, we provide a broader characterization of whitening-based activation-aware factorization that naturally covers rank-deficient activations, and show that the resulting projection is optimal in terms of layer output distortion. We then use output distortion as a proxy to allocate per-layer ranks under explicit FLOP or parameter count budgets, with negligible overhead via a Lagrangian relaxation of the allocation problem. translated_title: BALF：面向免微调模型压缩的预算约束激活感知低秩分解
translated_abstract: 激活感知低秩分解技术能够取得出色的压缩效果，但这类方法通常局限于线性层，且现有的基于白化的理论往往对层激活做出隐式的满秩假设。我们引入了一个层表示框架，使我们能够理解并将低秩分解扩展到线性层之外，包括标准卷积和分组卷积。在该框架内，我们对基于白化的激活感知分解给出了更广泛的刻画，能够自然地覆盖秩亏缺的激活，并证明了由此得到的投影在层输出失真意义上是最优的。随后，我们以输出失真作为代理指标，通过对该分配问题的拉格朗日松弛，以可忽略的开销在显式的FLOP或参数量预算下为各层分配秩。这些组件共同构成了BALF——一个端到端、免微调的模型压缩流水线。
tldr: 提出BALF框架，将激活感知低秩分解从线性层扩展到标准卷积和分组卷积并支持秩亏激活，同时基于输出失真在显式FLOP或参数预算下通过拉格朗日松弛自动分配各层秩，实现端到端免微调的模型压缩。
en_tdlr: BALF extends activation-aware low-rank factorization beyond linear layers to standard and grouped convolutions with rank-deficient activations, and optimally allocates per-layer ranks under explicit FLOP or parameter budgets via Lagrangian relaxation, enabling end-to-end fine-tuning-free model compression.
